# Df who noticed test

`customer_support.df.escalation_management.df_who_noticed_test` · v1.0.0 · **draft** · scope **capability** · kind **decision_framework**

> Who-Noticed Test — establish before anything else whether the customer raised this or we did, and branch the entire response on the answer.

It is the earliest available fork and the cheapest to evaluate, and getting it wrong contaminates every later step. Running it first also prevents the common drift where an internally-found problem is progressively re-narrated as a customer complaint.
